name: Fall Home Maintenance Checklist
description: A fall home maintenance checklist of autumn tasks that prepare your home for winter.

items.text: Schedule a professional furnace or heat-pump tune-up
Replace the furnace filter and stock spares for the season
items.note: Check 1-inch filters monthly through heating season

items.text: Test the heating system on a cool day before you need it
Bleed radiators or check boiler pressure on hydronic systems
Reverse ceiling fans to clockwise to circulate warm air down
Confirm the thermostat works and replace its batteries
Clean gutters and downspouts after most leaves have fallen
Inspect the roof from the ground for loose or missing shingles
Check flashing and seals around chimneys, vents and skylights
Confirm downspouts direct water at least three feet from the foundation
Rake leaves away from the foundation and clear window wells
Trim dead branches that could fall under snow or ice load
Drain and shut off outdoor faucets and sprinkler systems
Disconnect, drain and store garden hoses
Insulate exposed pipes in unheated areas like the garage and crawl space
Test the sump pump before winter storms and snowmelt
Locate the main water shut-off in case a pipe bursts
Apply weatherstripping to doors and seal drafty windows
Caulk gaps and cracks where pipes and wires enter the house
Check attic insulation depth and add more if it's thin
Install draft stoppers under exterior doors
Inspect and reverse or remove window AC units
Hire a certified chimney sweep before lighting the first fire
Test smoke and carbon-monoxide alarms and replace old batteries
items.note: CO risk rises in fall and winter with fuel-burning heat

items.text: Check the fireplace damper opens and closes fully
Inspect and recharge the kitchen fire extinguisher
Stock firewood in a dry, covered spot away from the house
Aerate, fertilize and overseed the lawn before frost
Clean and store outdoor furniture, grills and tools
Service and store the lawn mower; ready the snow blower
Stock up on ice melt and check that snow shovels are usable
Empty and store pots; protect tender plants from frost

faq.q: When should I do fall home maintenance?
faq.a: Start in early autumn and finish the major tasks — furnace service, gutter cleaning and pipe winterizing — before temperatures regularly fall below freezing so your home is ready for the first cold snap.

faq.q: Can I download this fall checklist as a PDF?
faq.a: Yes. You can print this fall home maintenance checklist or download it as a PDF and tick off tasks over a weekend or across several autumn weekends.

faq.q: Why is fall the best time to service the furnace?
faq.a: Servicing in fall confirms the furnace works safely before you rely on it daily, and HVAC technicians are easier to book than during the first winter cold snap when everyone calls at once.

faq.q: Do I really need to winterize outdoor faucets?
faq.a: Yes. Water left in outdoor faucets and hoses can freeze, expand and crack pipes, leading to leaks and water damage. Draining and shutting them off is a quick, cheap safeguard.

faq.q: Should I clean the chimney myself in fall?
faq.a: Hire a certified chimney sweep for wood-burning fireplaces and stoves. They remove creosote buildup that causes chimney fires and check for blockages and structural issues you can't safely see.
